description: Search products and services offered by local businesses in Austria (mainly Vienna and Lower Austria) listed on fixfind.at. Listings are in German, so use German search terms (e.g. "Möbelmontage", "Fotograf", "Felgenreparatur"). Filter by location (Austrian postal code like "1100", a prefix like "23", or a town name like "Mödling"), category and maximum price. Call without arguments to browse all offers. Returns short summaries; use get_offer for full details. Always give the user the offer url.

location.description: Austrian postal code (4 digits), postal code prefix, or town name. Optional.

max_price.description: Maximum price in EUR. Excludes offers without a price. Optional.

query.description: German search terms, e.g. "Umzug Wien" or "Passfoto". Optional.

name: search_offers
